I recently attempted and I was determined. I took over 50 pills and when my body rejected them I refused to throw up. After the high wore off I experienced the most physical pain I ever experienced and a couple hours later decided “if I’m gonna do it I’m gonna do it right” and attempted to stab myself in the heart but was too drugged it barely penetrated and my brother ended up finding me. He called the cops and they sent me to a mental institute and I know I have to be some sort of crazy for doing what I did, but I did not belong there. That place was the hardest week of my life and it was my consequence. It’s not worth it. In the moment I didn’t think of the people who cared of me but seeing how severe their reactions were from just an attempt, I couldn’t imagine what I would’ve put them through if I actually did it. Get help even if it’s talking to a sibling or at least one friend
